core_obligations: Affine-base reduction: separatedness is local on the base; restriction of (4) to opens proved inline via generic points of components of opens.

Finite-type reduction: X locally Noetherian => quasi-separated => the standard valuative criterion applies; two dotted arrows land in X_alpha \cup X_beta, an open finite-type subscheme satisfying (4) by the earlier inline remark.

Noetherian contradiction: non-closed diagonal point y in the closure of Delta(X_0); immersion image open in the closure bar-X_0; Krull-Akizuki (algebra-lemma-exists-dvr) gives a DVR dominating O_{bar-X_0,y}; nonexistence of a set-theoretic dotted arrow into the diagonal converts to non-uniqueness over S.
proof_roadmap: Finite-type reduction via quasi-separatedness of locally Noetherian lft.
Construct the DVR diagram from a boundary point of the diagonal; contradiction.
difficulty_reason: Three-stage reduction (affine base, finite type via Noetherian quasi-separatedness and local finiteness of the lft morphism, Noetherian contradiction) with an explicit Krull-Akizuki DVR diagram constructed from a non-closed diagonal point.
